meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成首次设置,跑通核心流程。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚拿到 omo,不知道第一步该做什么。
copy.tagline_en: Finish first-time setup and run through the core workflow.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just got omo and don't know the first step.

howto.what: 新用户第一次用 omo 时,Claude 按顺序带你走六条线:功能介绍、迁移旧配置、翻查历史会话、算缓存省钱估算、全程随时记录你的记忆,最后提议跑一次 init-deep。其中三条线需你同意才做,你拒绝它就往下走。
howto.when: 当新用户说想开始用 omo 时触发,且只会自动启动一次。之后可用 `senpi --onboard` 手动唤回,或用 `omo-senpi-onboarding-disabled` 关掉自动启动。

say.text: 我是新用户,带我过一遍 omo 吧
say.note: 它会依次讲解六条线,需要授权的先问你

say.text: 能把我以前的 Claude Code 配置迁过来吗
say.note: 它先扫描本机配置,给方案后等你确认才动手

say.text: 能翻一下我以前的历史会话吗

howto.what_en: For a first-time omo user, Claude walks six lanes in order: feature tour, migration, session archaeology, value mapping, memory recording, and a first-session init-deep proposal. Three lanes are opt-in; decline one and it moves on.
howto.when_en: Runs when a new user asks to get started with omo; it auto-starts once, ever. Bring it back with the `senpi --onboard` flag, or turn auto-start off with `omo-senpi-onboarding-disabled`.

say_en.text: I'm new here — walk me through omo.
say_en.note: Guides you through all six lanes in order.

say_en.text: Can you migrate my Claude Code setup over?
say_en.note: Scans local configs, shows a plan, waits for your OK.

say_en.text: Can you look through my past coding sessions?
say_en.note: Uses coding-agent-sessions to find and analyze them.
